_note: Strings a reader still sees in English after i18n.js has run, read off the rendered pages themselves: copy that a script writes into the page, which tools/i18n/extract.py never sees because it is not in the source. `en` is the text the browser holds, so its hash is the one i18n.js looks up; `where` and `pages` say where it was found. Harvested with tools/i18n/harvest.js, which only reports a string whose hash is in no dictionary.
